📸 @shotsbyticas 

Who Is OhGeesy?

OhGeesy is a Mexican-American rapper from Los Angeles, California, best known as a founding member of the legendary West Coast rap group Shoreline Mafia. He helped put a new generation of Los Angeles hip-hop on the map with his laid-back flow, catchy hooks, and signature West Coast sound.

After rising to fame with Shoreline Mafia through hits like “Musty,” “Bands,” and “Nun Major,” OhGeesy launched a successful solo career, releasing projects like GEEZYWORLD and GEEZYWORLD 2 and establishing himself as one of the biggest names in the new generation of West Coast rap.

On November 13, 2026, OhGeesy reached a massive milestone in his career, headlining the “Who Want The Smoke” festival at Viejas Arena in San Diego for his first-ever headlining arena show. The festival featured a stacked West Coast lineup, including 03 Greedo, Bravo The Bagchaser, Peysoh, Lou Deezi and more. Viejas Arena +1

With a reported sold-out crowd of over 8,000 fans, OhGeesy showed just how far he’s come from his early days with Shoreline Mafia. From underground Los Angeles rap shows to headlining arenas, his journey is a testament to his loyal fanbase, consistency and the continued rise of West Coast hip-hop. 🌴🔥

A HUGE moment not only for OhGeesy but for the entire West Coast music scene! 📈🏆
